claims.text: IVIG or plasma exchange: the treatments of choice;
claims.quote: Plasma exchange (PLEX) and IVIG are the treatments of choice (1).

claims.text: no plasma exchange after IVIG (removes it)
claims.quote: Plasma exchange theoretically removes any previously administered IVIG, negating its benefits, and should not be performed after IVIG.
Glucocorticoids are not indicated for treatment of Guillain-Barre syndrome; they do not hasten recovery and there is some evidence that they may delay recovery.
